title: Hogosh

our_entries.enemy_kind: Troll boss; he threw Gulsh out of the clan for missing his tolls (1351663225) and likes his Noglash Stew (1061620688).
location_evidence: "At the Troll Fort to North East" (663077754); "He can be found by the Troll Fort" (699838204); "in the Troll Village north-east of Sanctuary" (2558739045).
